title: MCP/REST recommend_next Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U8/U11/R15: `recommend_next`'s declared contract — a ranked, reasoned list of ready-to-learn skills, session-less (R6, R7, KTD3), sharing engine.rank_serve_candidates with select_next so the partner path and the internal path cannot diverge pedagogically. content_version (R15/KTD9) was missing from the shipped response until a code-review pass caught it; every catalog/graph/recommendation response must stamp it.

recommendations.description: Ordered by priority (due review -> remediation -> stepdown -> prereq_probe -> placement -> frontier).

unservable.description: True when the checked bank has no instances for this skill (KTD3) — never dropped from the list, only annotated.
